issue_request: FHIR-20502 asked to change ElementDefinition LOINC mapping headings from "LOINC Code" to "LOINC Field Name" and document why the ElementDefinition definitions link to the LOINC table structure, because the values are LOINC table field names rather than LOINC term codes.
initial_application: Git commit 1c4ff67fd8b1a5860f9fb1d6984eaab094137340 partially applied the issue by changing the LOINC mapping-space column name and expanding source/elementdefinition-mappings.html. It did not update the active source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml spreadsheet heading or the mapping-space title, leaving the current rendered mappings page with a LOINC summary link but no generated LOINC mapping section.
additional_context: ElementDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, so the spreadsheet and mapping pages are current build inputs. FHIR-16996 is an earlier same-change-family clarification about ElementDefinition LOINC mappings and supports keeping the explanation on the mappings page. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later or conflicting community decision.
reconciliation: Changed the spreadsheet column heading to "LOINC Field Name", changed the LOINC mapping-space title to "LOINC field name for the element", and clarified on the ElementDefinition mappings page that the values are LOINC table field names, not LOINC term codes.
